_comment: returns the indices it thinks match. Scored by F1, so partial
credit exists and a lucky single guess does not pass.
Why sentences and not synonyms: single-word synonym sets are what a
thesaurus API solves in one call, and they teach LFI's HDLM nothing
it could not get from a word list. These are paraphrases where the
wording barely overlaps and the DISTRACTOR shares most of the
vocabulary — so surface-token similarity gives the wrong answer and
the label is only obtainable from meaning. That is the signal worth
Two correct of four throughout: guessing the exact pair is 1 in 6,
and the F1 threshold (0.9) means near-misses do not pass either.
